name: order-tracker
description: Order and customer lookups via the order-tracker REST API

toolOverrides.name: get_order
toolOverrides.description: Get status, items, tracking number, carrier and estimated delivery for one order by order ID (e.g. ORD-001).

toolOverrides.name: get_customer_orders
toolOverrides.description: List all orders for a customer by customer ID (e.g. CUST-123).

toolOverrides.name: get_customer
toolOverrides.description: Get a customer's profile by customer ID (e.g. CUST-123).
